notes:
A fee group can now be marked HOSTELLERS ONLY, and every path that raises a demand honours it. Class Fee Demand used to bill the whole class even when the group was meant for hostellers alone, so day scholars were raised demands for hostel fees and somebody had to find and cancel them afterwards. It now bills only the students the group applies to. The Hostellers only box also stops sticking: picking a hostel-mapped group ticks it for that group and releases it again when you move to another, instead of silently carrying the restriction over to COLLEGE FEES.

Only a cash receipt can be cancelled. A receipt paid by online transfer, UPI, NEFT, cheque, DD or settled from an advance is returned through Fee Refund instead, which records where the money went. Cancelling those left the collection reconciled against the bank with nothing on the student's ledger to match it, and the difference only surfaced at month end. The Cancel screen now says which route to take for the receipt in front of you.

Student Ledger has been rebuilt. The student's name, register number, course and class sit at the top, with the balance as on today, and a band of cards showing total demand, concession, collected, refund and balance before the detail begins, so the position is clear without reading down the whole statement.

Daily Collection over a long date range works again. It was giving up partway and reporting "No collections in this range" on days that plainly had collections, which made the figure look wrong when it was only unfinished. The report is now several times faster, and if it ever does run out of time it says so instead of showing an empty day.

A bank account number can no longer be added twice. Each bank row carries its own online-payment settings, so the same account entered twice could route money two different ways; the second entry is now refused.

Miscellaneous collections take their receipt number from their own fee group's series. A HOSTEL FEES miscellaneous collection was coming out with a COLLEGE FEES receipt number.

On the Transactions screen the Amount and Type columns no longer run into each other.
